$comment: Explicit acknowledgements of intentional LARGE count changes (count-change guard: > 40 % fails the build). Each entry is pinned to the baseline dataset it accepts (baselineDatasetVersion = the datasetVersion of the manifest committed at git HEAD, see scripts/lib/baseline.ts): it applies only while that dataset is the baseline and is reported as stale afterwards — remove it in the commit after the change lands. Accepted changes are still listed (as warnings) in the build output, docs/DATA_QUALITY_REPORT.md and docs/CAMPUS_BUILDING_COVERAGE.md. A missing landmark is never accepted. Schema: scripts/lib/validate-changes.ts (countAcceptanceFileSchema). For a one-off local run use --accept-count-changes "<reason>" instead.

acceptances.reason: Schema v1 to v2 campus-only migration (owner decisions 1-3, docs/CAMPUS_GEOGRAPHY_AUDIT.md): footprints and POIs outside the OSM campus boundary (Law Gate area) leave the campus files; off-campus POIs move to context-places.json; uncertain boundary sections are held for review. The v1 counts covered the whole map rectangle, so building, place, category and relation counts drop by design.
acceptances.acceptedBy: Project lead, applying the site owner's decisions 1-3 of 2026-10-23 (reviewed before the v2 commit)
